_comment: Per model: add/remove geosets, pick textures (FileDataIDs) or pin the model file to a build whose skin file matches. Undead use the in-game defaults: Skin Type Bony (1901, 2901, 3001), Jaw Features Intact (102 / 202, without it the tabard shows through the jaw), Face Features Strapped (302), Hair Style Bald / Wild. Skyborne files have no listfile name: they come from ChrModel 218/219 and the first Skin Color, Face, Hair Style (hair geoset 2) and Hair Color choice in the ChrCustomization tables of WoW Forever 1.60.1.71091.
